en.hubeali:
And by this chain, from Muhammad Bin Jamhour, raising it, 
‘He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Rejects the repentance of the innovator (who introduces Bidha/heresy in religion)’.
It was said, ‘O Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>! And how come that is so?’ He<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘It is because his heart filled with the love of his (Bidha)’’.
en.sarwar: 4. It is narrated through the same chain of narrators from Muhammad ibn Jumhur in a marfu’ manner from the Messenger of Allah who has said the following. “Allah has rejected repentance of an innovator (in religion).”
People asked the holy Prophet as to why is this. The holy Prophet replied, “He (Allah) has quenched his heart with the love of his innovation.”
